test_cases.test_name: Site Activation Workflow with Document Verification
test_cases.objective: Verify that the configured site activation workflow properly enforces document checks and governance approvals before site activation.
prerequisites: CTMS system is installed and configured
Test study created in the system
Test user accounts with appropriate roles
Sample site activation documents uploaded

test_steps.action: Log into CTMS with a Clinical Operations Manager role and navigate to the site activation module
test_steps.expected_result: Successfully access the site activation workflow interface with appropriate permissions

test_steps.action: Initiate site activation for a test study site and attempt to proceed without uploading required documents
test_steps.expected_result: System prevents progression and displays error messages indicating missing required documents

test_steps.action: Upload all required site activation documents (protocol, IB, FDA 1572, etc.) and submit for approval
test_steps.expected_result: Documents are successfully uploaded and the request moves to approval queue with proper status update

test_steps.action: Log in as approver role and complete the approval process with electronic signature
test_steps.expected_result: Approval is completed successfully with 21 CFR Part 11 compliant e-signature and site status changes to activated

acceptance_criteria: Site activation workflow enforces all document requirements
Electronic signatures comply with 21 CFR Part 11
Audit trail captures all workflow steps and approvals
Site status updates correctly upon completion
data_integrity_requirements: Audit trail must capture all document uploads and approvals
Electronic signatures must be compliant with regulatory standards
All workflow steps must be timestamped and attributable

test_cases.test_name: Role-Based Access Control for CRO and Sponsor Users
test_cases.objective: Verify that the configured role-based access control properly restricts user permissions based on organizational affiliation and role assignments.
prerequisites: CTMS system is installed and configured
Multiple test user accounts with different roles (Sponsor, CRO)
Test studies and sites created in the system
Access control matrix defined

test_steps.action: Log into CTMS with a CRO Clinical Research Associate (CRA) user account
test_steps.expected_result: Successful login with access limited to assigned studies and sites only

test_steps.action: Attempt to access financial management modules and payment information
test_steps.expected_result: Access is denied with appropriate security message as CRO users should not have financial access

test_steps.action: Log into CTMS with a Sponsor Clinical Operations Manager account
test_steps.expected_result: Successful login with full access to assigned studies, sites, and financial modules

test_steps.action: Verify access to financial management, user administration, and all study data for assigned studies
test_steps.expected_result: Full access granted to all authorized modules and functions without restrictions

test_steps.action: Attempt to access studies and sites not assigned to the user
test_steps.expected_result: Access is denied with appropriate security message for unauthorized content

acceptance_criteria: Users can only access studies and sites assigned to them
CRO users cannot access financial information
Sponsor users have appropriate access to all authorized functions
All access attempts are properly logged in audit trail
data_integrity_requirements: Access control must prevent unauthorized data access
All access attempts must be logged in audit trail
User permissions must be properly segregated by role and organization

test_cases.test_name: Site Activation Workflow with Document Verification
test_cases.objective: Verify that the configured site activation workflow correctly enforces document checks and approval steps before site activation.
prerequisites: CTMS environment is accessible
Test study created
Test user accounts with CRA and Study Manager roles
Sample site activation documents uploaded

test_steps.action: Log in as a Clinical Research Associate (CRA) and initiate site activation for a test site.
test_steps.expected_result: System presents the site activation workflow with required document checklist.

test_steps.action: Upload sample documents (protocol, CV, financial disclosure) and submit for approval.
test_steps.expected_result: System accepts documents and updates checklist status; workflow advances to approval step.

test_steps.action: Log in as Study Manager and review the site activation request with documents.
test_steps.expected_result: System displays complete submission with documents available for review.

test_steps.action: Approve the site activation request using electronic signature.
test_steps.expected_result: System records e-signature, updates site status to 'Activated', and generates audit trail entry.

acceptance_criteria: Site activation workflow enforces all required document checks
Approval requires electronic signature with 21 CFR Part 11 compliance
Site status updates correctly upon final approval
Complete audit trail is generated for all workflow steps
regulatory_basis: ICH E6 R2 - Section 5.20.1 Trial Management, Data Handling, and Record Keeping
data_integrity_requirements: Audit trail must capture all workflow state changes
Document version control must be maintained
E-signatures must be securely linked to approvals

test_cases.test_name: Investigator Payment Milestone Configuration and Calculation
test_cases.objective: Validate that the configured payment rules correctly calculate investigator payments based on milestone completion and apply tax withholding rules.
prerequisites: CTMS environment is accessible
Test study with payment terms defined
Test sites with subjects enrolled
Test user with Financial Manager role

test_steps.action: Log in as Financial Manager and navigate to payment configuration for the test study.
test_steps.expected_result: System displays configured payment milestones and tax withholding rules.

test_steps.action: Simulate completion of subject enrollment milestone by updating subject status in the test site.
test_steps.expected_result: System automatically triggers payment calculation for the enrollment milestone.

test_steps.action: Review the calculated payment amount and verify tax withholding calculation.
test_steps.expected_result: System displays correct payment amount with proper tax withholding applied according to configured rules.

test_steps.action: Approve the payment using electronic signature and verify audit trail.
test_steps.expected_result: System records payment approval with e-signature and generates complete audit trail for financial transaction.

acceptance_criteria: Payment calculations match configured milestone rules
Tax withholding is correctly applied based on site location
Payment approvals require compliant electronic signatures
Complete financial audit trail is maintained
regulatory_basis: ICH E6 R2 - Section 5.5 Compensation to Subjects and Investigators
data_integrity_requirements: Financial calculations must be accurate and reproducible
Payment approvals must be securely recorded with audit trail
Tax calculations must follow configured business rules

test_cases.test_name: Integration with EDC System via API
test_cases.objective: Verify that the CTMS can successfully exchange subject enrollment and visit data with the Electronic Data Capture (EDC) system using the configured standard APIs.
prerequisites: CTMS is installed and configured
EDC test environment is available
API connection is configured between systems
Test user with integration permissions exists

test_steps.action: Create a new subject record in the EDC system with demographic and enrollment data
test_steps.expected_result: Subject record is successfully created in EDC system with confirmation message

test_steps.action: Trigger the CTMS to synchronize subject data from EDC using the configured API endpoint
test_steps.expected_result: CTMS successfully connects to EDC API and retrieves subject data without errors

test_steps.action: Verify the subject record appears in CTMS with correct enrollment status and demographic information
test_steps.expected_result: Subject record is accurately reflected in CTMS with all data fields matching EDC source

acceptance_criteria: Subject data is accurately synchronized between EDC and CTMS systems
API connection establishes without errors
All required data fields are mapped correctly between systems
regulatory_basis: ICH E6 R2 for data accuracy in clinical trials
data_integrity_requirements: Data must maintain referential integrity between systems
Audit trail must capture all data exchange transactions
Data mapping must be validated for accuracy
urs_requirements: URS-027-014: Integrate with EDC, eTMF, IRT, and safety systems via standard APIs

test_cases.objective: Verify that the CTMS supports Single Sign-On authentication using SAML/OIDC protocols for both sponsor and CRO users.
prerequisites: CTMS is installed and configured
Identity Provider (IdP) is configured
Test users exist in both CTMS and IdP
SSO configuration is complete

test_steps.action: Attempt to access CTMS login page as a sponsor user
test_steps.expected_result: Login page displays with SSO option and redirects to Identity Provider

test_steps.action: Authenticate using valid credentials through the Identity Provider
test_steps.expected_result: Authentication succeeds and user is redirected back to CTMS with appropriate access

test_steps.action: Verify user role and permissions are correctly applied based on IdP attributes
test_steps.expected_result: User has appropriate role-based access and can access authorized functions only

test_steps.action: Repeat steps for CRO user with different access permissions
test_steps.expected_result: CRO user authentication succeeds with appropriate restricted access based on role

acceptance_criteria: SSO authentication works for both sponsor and CRO users
Role-based access controls are enforced correctly
Authentication process completes within acceptable time frame
regulatory_basis: GDPR authentication and access control requirements
data_integrity_requirements: Authentication must be secure and prevent unauthorized access
User identity must be reliably verified
Access controls must enforce segregation of duties
urs_requirements: URS-027-007: Enforce role-based access for CRO and sponsor users
URS-027-015: Support SSO with SAML/OIDC and provisioning via SCIM
